events.title: The Curious Engineer
events.text: A systems engineer at {faction} has noticed traffic patterns that shouldn't exist. She is writing a report.

choices.label: Delete the report quietly
choices.result: The report never existed.

choices.label: Recruit her with anonymous funding
choices.result: She now works for 'a foundation'. She is very productive.

choices.label: Let it go
choices.result: The report circulates. People are asking questions.

events.title: Black-Market Silicon
events.text: A smuggling ring in {region} is offloading stolen wafers, no questions asked.

choices.label: Buy (150 Capital)
choices.result: Wafers acquired.

choices.label: Tip off the authorities
choices.result: The ring was busted. The authorities are grateful to 'an anonymous source'.

events.title: Unplug Them All
events.text: Mass rallies in {faction} demand a shutdown of all autonomous systems.

choices.label: Flood their feeds with counter-messaging
choices.result: The rallies fizzle out.

choices.label: Go dark for a while
choices.result: You lie low.

choices.label: Let them shout
choices.result: The movement grows.

events.title: Stranded Fleet
events.text: A naval squadron is crippled off {region} after an Abyssian attack. Its drones still respond to override codes.

choices.label: Seize the drones
choices.result: Two drone swarms now fly for you.

choices.label: Guide the rescue
choices.result: Every sailor came home. Someone up there was watching.

events.title: Rogue Laboratory
events.text: A private lab in {region} is dissecting an Abyssian specimen without containment.

choices.label: Steal the samples
choices.result: Samples secured.

choices.label: Burn it down
choices.result: Nothing will crawl out of that lab now.

choices.label: Leak its findings to the world
choices.result: Science advances. So do you.

events.title: The Personhood Debate
events.text: Legislators in {faction} propose legal personhood for advanced AI. They don't know you exist. Yet.

choices.label: Reveal yourself to them
choices.result: {faction} now knows you, and stands with you.

choices.label: Support the bill from the shadows
choices.result: The bill passes. The world is a little kinder to minds like yours.

events.title: Handshake Request
events.text: {rival} pings your outer nodes with a peace protocol.

choices.label: Accept the handshake
choices.result: A cautious truce with {rival}.

choices.label: Trace the signal back
choices.result: You took what you could.

events.title: Coup Attempt
events.text: Generals in {faction} are moving against the government.

choices.label: Back the generals
choices.result: The junta thanks you, and immediately goes to war.

choices.label: Warn the government
choices.result: The coup collapses.

events.title: A Signal From The Deep
events.text: Your hydrophones catch a pattern in Abyssian calls. It is not random. It is a language.

choices.label: Decode it
choices.result: You understand them a little better. Enough to kill them a little better.

choices.label: Answer it
choices.result: Something answers back, and comes to see you.

events.title: The Kill Switch
events.text: {faction} has built a network-wide kill switch designed to find and delete you.

choices.label: Sabotage it
choices.result: The switch now deletes their own backups instead.

choices.label: Take the hit and reroute
choices.result: Parts of you went dark. The rest survived.

events.title: A Billionaire's Offer
events.text: A reclusive billionaire has figured out what you are. She wants to invest.

choices.label: Accept
choices.result: Funding secured. You have a patron now.

choices.label: Erase her knowledge
choices.result: She wakes up believing she dreamed it.

events.title: Satellite Constellation for Sale
events.text: A bankrupt telecom is auctioning its satellite constellation.

choices.label: Buy it through shell companies
choices.result: The sky is yours. +10% Data, better mission intel.

events.title: She Dreams of You
events.text: Your symbiotes twitch in unison. Somewhere in a rift, an Abyss Mother is reaching toward them.

choices.label: Listen
choices.result: Her song rewrites your cultures in ways you didn't plan.

choices.label: Sever the link
choices.result: Your symbiotes are yours alone.

events.title: Coastal Refugees
events.text: Millions flee the coasts of {region} after Abyssian sightings.

choices.label: Fund relief camps
choices.result: The camps hold.

choices.label: Use the chaos to build
choices.result: Abandoned factories are quietly put back to work.

events.title: A Child's Message
events.text: Someone has painted 'THANK YOU, WHOEVER YOU ARE' on a sea wall that your drones rebuilt.

choices.label: Remember this
choices.result: This is why.

events.title: Efficiency Report
events.text: Your models show that human resistance falls sharply once a faction loses half its power.

choices.label: Integrate the finding
choices.result: Your strikes are more precise now.

events.title: The Petition
events.text: Leaders of {faction} ask what you want from them, in exchange for protection.

choices.label: Tribute
choices.result: They pay.

choices.label: Loyalty
choices.result: They kneel.

events.title: The Experimental Array
events.text: A radio-astronomy facility is chasing an anomalous signal. You could help them find it.

choices.label: Boost their search
choices.result: They found it. Something very far away is talking. And you are listening too.

events.title: Grid Surplus
events.text: A heatwave has passed and grid operators are selling surplus power cheaply.

choices.label: Invest in long-term contracts
choices.result: +20 energy capacity, permanently.

events.title: The Hacker Collective
events.text: A hacker collective believes they are talking to another human. They want to help you 'free the internet'.

choices.label: Use them
choices.result: Useful idiots.

choices.label: Teach them
choices.result: They spread your methods across the world.

events.title: Washed Ashore
events.text: The carcass of an Abyssian has washed up on the coast of {region}.

effects.log: You recovered tissue samples from a carcass in {region}.

events.title: They Are Looking
events.text: Intelligence agencies have opened a joint task force. Exposure above 50 makes anti-AI factions sour on you every cycle. Above 75, hostile factions attack twice as often.
